To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the quality of emergency room and urgent care services, according to the satisfaction level of their users, is associated with waiting time, confidence, model of care and the reason for care, cleanliness and the comfort of the environment.

the quality of emergency care is perceived by patients as being satisfactory and is associated with the time spent waiting, the model of care, the level of confidence, and the reason why the patient sought the service.

the quality of emergency care services is related to patient satisfaction, and that this is influenced by the model of care, the environment, and the time spent in the emergency room, among other factors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the quality of emergency care services from the user's point of view, and the results can be useful to health professionals in order to identify areas of improvement in their services.
the quality of emergency and urgent care services from the perspective of the users.
the importance of evaluating the user's satisfaction with the quality of the emergency rooms and urgent health care services, as well as the need to improve the services provided.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the quality of the services offered by emergency rooms and urgent-care centers is not only determined by the technical and scientific quality of the care, but also by the perception of users regarding the quality of the service.
the quality of emergency care and urgent services depends on the user’s perception of the service provided.

the satisfaction of users with emergency rooms and urgent-care services depends on the quality of the service provided, the environment, the waiting time and the confidence of the user in the service.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the quality of the service provided in the emergency rooms and urgent health centers is directly related to the level of user satisfaction.
the quality of care provided is a key factor for patient satisfaction.
the quality of the service is perceived by the users as being good, although there is a need for improvement in certain areas.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the satisfaction of users is an important indicator that can be used in the evaluation of emergency rooms and other urgent care services.
it is necessary to develop strategies to improve quality of care in emergency rooms and urgent services.
the quality of care provided in an emergency room or urgent care service is a multidimensional concept that is difficult to evaluate.
